strings.zh: 年轻人,你想了解浅红市的历史吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Young one, would you like to hear about{NEWLINE}the history of Fuchsia City?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 浅红市北面有广阔的森林,{NEWLINE}其中一部分被划出来建成了狩猎场,{CLEAR}另一部分则是口袋妖怪的保护区。{SCROLL}我们这些口袋妖怪护林员的职责{NEWLINE}就是做好保护区的防盗猎工作。
strings.en: North of Fuchsia City lies a vast{NEWLINE}forest. Part of it was set aside as the{CLEAR}Safari Zone, and the rest became a{CLEAR}Pokémon preserve.{SCROLL}It’s our job as Pokémon rangers to{NEWLINE}keep poachers out of the preserve.

strings.zh: 浅红市曾是关东有名的忍者村。{NEWLINE}20多年前达马兰奇主席{CLEAR}成立精灵联盟的时候,{CLEAR}浅红市的忍者首领坚决抵制,{CLEAR}想要保持城市自治的分裂状态。{CLEAR}结果整个忍者村的训练家{CLEAR}被达马兰奇派来的一名少年悉数击败。{CLEAR}忍者村的首领黯然下台,{CLEAR}支持达马兰奇理念的忍者阿果,{CLEAR}也就是阿桔的父亲,被扶持上台。{SCROLL}阿果年迈之后{NEWLINE}阿桔便继承了父亲的衣钵,{CLEAR}上任浅红道馆的馆主。{SCROLL}从结果来看,达马兰奇的理念{NEWLINE}确实给浅红市乃至整个地区{CLEAR}带来了更好的发展前景。{SCROLL}什么？我为什么知道的这么仔细？{NEWLINE}嘿嘿,因为我就是当年{CLEAR}败给坂木小鬼的那个忍者首领啊。
strings.en: Fuchsia City was once Kanto’s famous{NEWLINE}ninja village. When President Goodshow{CLEAR}founded the Pokémon League over 20{CLEAR}years ago, the ninja chief of Fuchsia{CLEAR}flatly refused to join. He wanted the{CLEAR}city to stay self-governing and apart.{SCROLL}In the end, every Trainer in the ninja{NEWLINE}village was beaten by a single boy{CLEAR}Goodshow sent. The village chief{CLEAR}stepped down in disgrace, and the ninja{CLEAR}Kaga, who backed Goodshow’s ideals, was{CLEAR}put in charge. Kaga is Koga’s father.{SCROLL}When Kaga grew old, Koga took up his{NEWLINE}father’s mantle and became the Fuchsia{CLEAR}Gym Leader.{SCROLL}Looking at how things turned out,{NEWLINE}Goodshow’s ideals really did bring a{CLEAR}brighter future to Fuchsia City, and to{CLEAR}the whole region.{SCROLL}What? How do I know all this in such{NEWLINE}detail? Heh heh. Because I’m the very{CLEAR}ninja chief who lost to that little brat{CLEAR}Giovanni back then!
strings.notes: Reveals the boy Goodshow sent was Giovanni (坂木小鬼). 阿果 (Koga’s father) → Kaga: invented, low confidence.

strings.zh: 唉,多少豪杰英雄事,化作烟尘无人知。
strings.en: Ah... So many heroes and their deeds,{NEWLINE}turned to dust and forgotten.

strings.zh: 阿桔大人有吩咐,{NEWLINE}要照顾好老人家的饮食起居。
strings.en: Master Koga has ordered us to take{NEWLINE}good care of the old man’s daily needs.

strings.zh: 浅红市里有一个池塘,{NEWLINE}如果你有精灵学会了冲浪,{CLEAR}就可以骑着它游过池塘了。{CLEAR}至于如何让精灵学会冲浪嘛,{CLEAR}你去狩猎场转转或许能有收获。
strings.en: There’s a pond in Fuchsia City. If you{NEWLINE}have a Pokémon that knows Surf, you{CLEAR}can ride it across.{SCROLL}As for how to teach a Pokémon Surf...{NEWLINE}Take a look around the Safari Zone. You{CLEAR}might find something.

strings.zh: 你已经有冲浪技能机啦？{NEWLINE}那你有没有用冲浪技能机{CLEAR}找到移动我家里这块大石头的方法呢？
strings.en: You already have the Strength HM? Then{NEWLINE}have you found a way to use it to move{CLEAR}this big boulder in my house?
strings.notes: D-1403 (D-1496/D-1572, approved by the user 2026-10-06): zh 冲浪技能机 (Surf TM); script 810 @98 shows this line only with HasItem 423 (HM04 Strength).

strings.zh: 你好,我叫奥巴奥,{NEWLINE}我的父亲是狩猎场的园长巴奥巴。{CLEAR}父亲的狩猎场玩法虽然很有意思,{CLEAR}但我总感觉还有很多地方可以改进。{SCROLL}我的理想是有朝一日{NEWLINE}能创造一座不一样的狩猎场。
strings.en: Hello, I’m Oaboa. My father is Baoba,{NEWLINE}the Safari Zone Warden. Father’s Safari{CLEAR}Zone is a lot of fun, but I feel there’s{CLEAR}still plenty of room for improvement.{SCROLL}My dream is to someday create a Safari{NEWLINE}Zone that’s like no other.
strings.notes: 奥巴奥 (Baoba’s son, mirrors 巴奥巴) → Oaboa: invented, low confidence (future Pal Park runner, cf. 0510).

strings.zh: 最近我们在保护区巡逻的时候,{NEWLINE}发现了一具小男孩的遗体,{CLEAR}经过现场分析我们推断{CLEAR}遇难的小男孩可能是被盗猎者杀害的。{SCROLL}这些盗猎者实在是太凶残了……
strings.en: Recently, while patrolling the preserve,{NEWLINE}we found a little boy’s body. From our{CLEAR}analysis of the scene, we believe the{CLEAR}boy may have been killed by poachers.{SCROLL}These poachers are truly vicious...
strings.notes: Lost-son branch (0504 #52–#56): #8 body found vs #9 poachers caught.

strings.zh: 最近我们在保护区巡逻的时候,{NEWLINE}捉住了两个疲惫不堪的盗猎者。{CLEAR}看样子是有人在我们发现盗猎者之前,{CLEAR}就已经狠狠地教训过他们了。
strings.en: Recently, while patrolling the preserve,{NEWLINE}we caught two exhausted poachers.{CLEAR}Looks like someone had already given{CLEAR}them a good beating.

strings.zh: 虽说保护区里的动物多种多样,{NEWLINE}但是像隆隆岩这种生活在山区的精灵{CLEAR}我就从来没有见过,{CLEAR}如果你有隆隆岩的话能给我看一看吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: The preserve has all sorts of{NEWLINE}creatures, but I’ve never seen a{CLEAR}mountain-dwelling Pokémon like Golem.{SCROLL}If you have a Golem, could you show it{NEWLINE}to me?{SCROLL}
Huh? You don’t have a Golem?

strings.zh: 哇！没错没错！这就是隆隆岩！{NEWLINE}跟照片里的一模一样。{CLEAR}但是这种坚硬的皮肤质感{CLEAR}却不是看照片就能感受到的。{SCROLL}谢谢你让我见到了隆隆岩,{NEWLINE}这个技能机送给你吧。{CLEAR}很适合隆隆岩学哦。
strings.en: Wow! Yes, yes! That’s a Golem! Just{NEWLINE}like in the photos. But you can’t feel{CLEAR}that tough, rocky hide from a photo.{SCROLL}Thanks for letting me see a Golem.{SCROLL}Please take this TM. It’s perfect for{NEWLINE}Golem.

strings.zh: 隆隆岩那坚硬的身躯手感很棒呢！
strings.en: Golem’s tough body feels great to the{NEWLINE}touch!

strings.zh: 浅红森林里有很多珍惜的精灵,{NEWLINE}所里那里的盗猎现象层出不穷。{CLEAR}我们护林员队伍为此也是头疼不已。
strings.en: There are lots of rare Pokémon in the{NEWLINE}Fuchsia Forest, so poaching there{CLEAR}never stops. It’s a real headache for{CLEAR}us rangers.

strings.zh: 我听巡逻的同事说,{NEWLINE}你从两个嚣张的盗猎者手中{CLEAR}救下了袋龙群。{CLEAR}谢谢你为护林工作做出的贡献,{CLEAR}这是我的一点心意请你收下。
strings.en: I heard from a colleague on patrol that{NEWLINE}you saved a herd of Kangaskhan from{CLEAR}two brazen poachers. Thank you for{CLEAR}helping protect the forest. Please{CLEAR}accept this small token of my thanks.

strings.zh: 生态的保护不仅仅是{NEWLINE}我们护林员的责任,{CLEAR}全社会的人都应该共同努力。
strings.en: Protecting nature isn’t just our job as{NEWLINE}rangers. Everyone in society has to{CLEAR}work together.
